title: Vintage wheel square
subtitle: A circular wheel motif centred in a square border, worked in the round
excerpt: A circular wheel of radiating treble spokes fills the centre of the motif, then a square border round closes the circle into a square. The wheel spokes and the square corners are offset, giving the motif a compass-rose quality. Five rounds in DK cotton produce a 12 cm tile.
sourceNotes: Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 3 (1888), wheel-and-square motif chapter (Internet Archive). Therese de Dillmont, Encyclopedia of Needlework (1886), spoke motifs.
heroPrompt: A vintage wheel crochet square in warm cream DK cotton on a pale linen background, photographed flat from above in soft daylight. Eight radiating spokes inside a square border, 12 cm across.

crochet.gaugeText: Finished vintage wheel square measures 12 × 12 cm in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.

chartDefinition.title: Vintage wheel square
chartDefinition.caption: Rounds 1–3 build the wheel. Round 4 transitions from round to square. Round 5 adds the square border.

glossaryTerms.definition: Converting a circular crochet motif into a square by working a transition round that picks up four equally spaced points on the circle as the new corners of the square border.

content.text: The vintage wheel square builds eight radiating spokes in the first three rounds, then uses a
transition on round 4 to anchor four corner clusters onto the wheel, converting the circular motif to a square. Round 5 adds the outer granny-style border.

The transition round places corner clusters at every other spoke position (4 of the 8 spokes become corners). The intermediate 4 spokes become mid-side positions on the square border, producing a subtle octagonal shadow inside the square outline.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 12 g of DK-weight cotton. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle, scissors.

content.text: Rounds 1–3: magic ring. Work 8 spoke pairs (2 tr, ch 2 per spoke) radiating from the ring. Expand each spoke pair outward with additional trebles on rounds 2 and 3, building an 8-section circular wheel.
Round 4: at every other spoke tip (4 evenly spaced), work a corner cluster (3 tr, ch 2, 3 tr). At the other 4 spokes, work 3 tr into the ch-2 sp. Sl st to join.
Round 5: granny-style border round. Corner clusters at ch-2 corners; 3 tr into each side ch-1 sp. Fasten off.
For a similar wheel-in-square construction with more rounds, try the join-as-you-go square to see how this motif attaches to its neighbours on the final round.
